whyFree.heading: Why is so much free?
whyFree.body: Spellful believes spiritual education should be accessible to everyone. Plus supports the platform so we can keep the core experience free for all.

faq.question: What is Spellful Plus?
faq.answer: Spellful Plus is a monthly subscription that unlocks advanced profile customization, unlimited practice routines, celestial themes, exclusive avatar frames, and more — while supporting free spiritual education for everyone.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. You'll keep Plus access until the end of your current billing period.

faq.question: Will I lose my data if I cancel?
faq.answer: No. Your journal entries, readings, and saved content remain yours. Some Plus-exclusive features will become inaccessible, but your data is always safe.

faq.question: Is Plus available on iOS and Android?
faq.answer: Yes. Spellful Plus is available on iOS, Android, and web. Your subscription works across all platforms.

faq.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faq.answer: On iOS, payment is handled through Apple's App Store. On Android, through Google Play. On web, we accept major credit and debit cards.
